section_summary.extract_value: This Conclusions section discusses findings on self-compassion as a protective factor for young adult women against body image threats. The results indicate that women do not need higher baseline self-compassion levels, but rather should cultivate higher-than-usual self-compassion on days when body image stressors are elevated. The section emphasizes the importance of daily fluctuations in self-compassion relative to individual baseline levels.
